text:
leo (People Ops): Quick heads-up: launching a 4-month parental leave top-up pilot + digital receipts for travel expenses. Read the brief below.
anya (Benefits): Pilot details: eligible full-time parents primary caregiver get a top-up to 8 weeks of pay at 80% for the first 12 weeks of parental leave, pilot runs Jul 1 - Oct 31. Applies to births and primary adoption placements.
sam (eng): Nice. Who's eligible for the pilot? Contractors?
anya (Benefits): Eligibility: FT employees with 6+ months tenure. Contractors and temps excluded for now. We'll evaluate expanding after pilot.
rebecca (finance): Payroll note: top-ups coded as PLT-2026; payroll needs leave approval + benefits claim by the leave start date. Retro claims allowed if submitted within 30 days of leave start.
leo (People Ops): Digital receipts: expense-bot will accept photos via Slack DM or mobile app and auto-attach to Concur under code TRV-REC. Live next week. This reduces lost receipts friction.
expense-bot: New feature: DM me a photo of your receipt and include expense code (e.g., TRV-REC) and I'll attach it to your next Concur submission. Link: https://tools.redwood/expense-bot
sam (eng): Any privacy concerns with receipts that include personal data?
rebecca (finance): We'll redact sensitive info (IDs, full card numbers) server-side before storing. Finance retains receipts per retention policy. See docs: https://intranet.redwood/finance/receipts-policy
leo (People Ops): We'll run info sessions next Tue + Thurs 11am PT to walk through signups and the digital receipts flow. If you want to opt into pilot early, email anya@redwood.com with subject "Parental Pilot Opt-in".
anya (Benefits): Survey for pilot volunteers: https://surveys.redwood/parental-topup. Please fill even if not applying, helps planning.
sam (eng): Thanks team, excited about this.
leo (People Ops): Thanks all — questions welcome, ping @leo or @anya.
